handle_animal.name: Handle Animal
handle_animal.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Handle Animal gives +2 on Ride checks and wild empathy checks with animals.

actions.name: Direct Animal to Perform Known Trick
actions.description: Command a domesticated or trained animal companion or mount to execute a known trick.

actions.name: Push Animal Beyond Normal Habits
actions.description: Urge an animal to perform a trick it does not know, or to face unnatural perils like fire or undead.
